events.title: HOTA Farmers and Artisan Market
events.location: HOTA Precinct, 135 Bundall Rd, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A curated outdoor market showcasing local artisans, farmers, and organic produce creators set within the HOTA arts precinct. It serves as a community hub for locals to engage with small-scale makers and food growers.

events.title: Anna Carey, Magic + Memory: make me a home
events.source: HOTA, supported by Experience Gold Coast
events.description: An immersive exhibition by Anna Carey exploring themes of memory, architecture, and nostalgia through photographs and model-making. It offers a thoughtful space to reflect on the concept of home and constructed identity.
